## Scope

This report evaluates the implementation from an **independent R session** without relying on objects from the exploratory notebook. The limits on the \(\tau\) scale are handled by an auxiliary layer and do not replace the GAMLSS RS estimator.

\[
Z_i\mid Y_i\sim\operatorname{Bin}(m_i,Y_i),\qquad
Y_i\sim t\operatorname{Simplex}(\mu_i,\phi_i,\nu_i),\qquad
\tau_i=(1+\nu_i)^{-1}.
\]

## Main validation

```{r evaluation, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Knit this report from the project root directory.
source("run_all_tests.R", local = TRUE)
```

## Reproducibility note

Results depend on R and package versions, the compiler, numerical libraries, and quadrature precision. The checks cover specific scenarios and do not establish a uniform error bound over the entire parameter space. The weighted population GAMLSS example can also be run separately using `Rscript run_all_tests.R --fit`.
